thread:
Alex: Heads up — saw a regression on mistral-8x7b (AWQ) after the kernel-selector change (commit 9f3a). 95p token latency up ~22%, median flat. Also KV cache evictions spiked on dedicated pool.
Morgan: Oof. Did you run a flamegraph or perf trace? Which kernel is being picked now vs before?
Alex: Quick profile snippet I ran locally with loadgen:
```bash
run_profile --model mistral-8x7b --quant awq --batch 1 --seq 1024 --kernels
# abridged output:
selected_kernel: aten_rope_opt_v2
latency_p95: 86ms -> 105ms
kv_evictions: 14/min -> 79/min
```
So the selector now picks aten_rope_opt_v2 for long sequences instead of the previous aten_rope_opt_v1.
Priya: That kernel swap shouldn't, by itself, cause kv evictions. The selector patch also touched batching/prefetch heuristics right? Any config diffs?
Jamal: I instrumented KV warmup across traces — the prefetch window dropped from 64 tokens to 24 due to the new batching heuristic that biases towards microbatch throughput. Fewer warmup tokens -> more cold cache population -> evictions when requests hit larger seq lengths.
Alex: Reproducer + config I used:
```json
{"batching": {"max_batch_size": 16, "warmup_prefetch": 24}, "kernel_selector": {"prefer_fast_rope": true}}
```
This is the canary config applied last night.
Morgan: Can you force the old kernel to confirm? Try `RUNTIME_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=aten_rope_opt_v1 ./serve --model mistral-8x7b --quant awq` and rerun the profile.
Alex: Did that. Forced aten_rope_opt_v1 -> rerun: p95 back to 84ms, kv_evictions down to ~10/min. So it's the interaction of kernel selection + reduced prefetch window.
Priya: Action items: 1) short-term: reinstate prefetch=64 for AWQ quantized Mistral/Mixtral family or for models with rope_scale > 1.1; 2) medium: update kernel-selector to consider quantization profile and head/kv dim patterns before preferring aten_rope_opt_v2; 3) add CI perf test for AWQ/mistral that checks p95 < baseline.
Jamal: I'll open a PR with the kernel-selector guard and a canary flag `ropekv.prefetch_window=64` that infra can toggle. I'll also add a minimal nightly perf job that runs the AWQ path and fails CI if regress >10%.
perf-bot: Perf alert created: `/alerts/awq-mistral-kernel-selector` — will post to #eng-runtime for regressions >10%.
infra-bot: Hotfix flag `ropekv.prefetch_window=64` rolled to canary (us-west-2-dedicated). Monitoring 30m.
Alex: Thanks — attaching flamegraphs & full logs to the PR, will include a small reproducer harness and the exact loadgen commands. @Jamal please include candidate calibration prompts too so AWQ-specific kernels get coverage (e.g., long-context math/text mix). :eyes:
